entries: Sessions take less disk space: Auto-review no longer saves a separate log file of the reviewer's own conversation. To keep those logs, set `approval_judge.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`
On Linux, a sandboxed command whose placeholder bookkeeping was lost no longer leaves an empty placeholder folder in your project once the command sharing it has finished
If the session log can't save a new session's first model request, the turn now stops with a retryable storage error instead of calling the model; the request is saved once the write succeeds
Cancelling a workflow no longer reports a child's own task as one of that child's killed background tasks
In an untrusted folder, `muse exec` now says that project MCP servers in `.mcp.json` were not loaded and how to load them, and `muse mcp list` says why and how to load them
Restarting a session no longer drops its most recent turn when that turn repeats the instructions or rules of an earlier, finished turn

A side chat opened through `muse serve` or the TypeScript and Python SDKs now starts empty instead of showing the turns of the conversation it came from (side chats opened before this update still show those turns and, while open, count them in the session list)

A metadata-only `session/read` or `session/resume` (`excludeItems`) does less work on long sessions; a session whose saved history is over the read cap now gets its pending requests and last turn back instead of `noneReason: "projectionReadLimit"`
A `session/read` right after `session/resume` no longer reads the whole log again for a session that never compacted; it reads only what the resume added
Resuming a long session without a saved checkpoint uses less memory while it starts, because the records it starts from are no longer copied once for each part of the session that reads them
